collection_status_note: Five fresh homepage entries and five distinct detail attempts. Four details succeeded; Subway Surfers rendered a 404 title. scope.sampling_rule: Up to first ten entries from the rendered 热门免费游戏 numbered list; five present, all retained. First five distinct linked details inspected. Only this selected numbered recommendation section sampled for continuity; no filler entries or extra sections added.

source_extensions.detail_navigation_note: Cloud browser only; no gameplay input, votes, login or hidden APIs. Cookie consent was rejected. A Smash Karts download timed out; its detail was reopened to obtain preserved fresh evidence.

limitations: Bounded nonrandom sample; not a complete catalog or independently verified popularity ranking.
Only one selected homepage numbered list with five entries; no games added to fill the maximum.
Homepage numbering and detail popularity ranks remain separate. Smash Karts has no observed detail popularity rank in this run.
K/M values are approximate source abbreviations; votes are not plays, unique users or concurrency.
No numeric online display observed in inspected details this run; all online values are null. A 5,000+ display must be a >=5000 lower bound, never exact CCU.
Subway Surfers rendered a 404 title and missing-page message. HTTP status was not exposed; permanent delisting is not established.

Three returned cover files passed full image decoding, byte size, SHA-256 and dimension checks but lack HTTP status and response Content-Type verification. Smash Karts download outcome is uncertain after a tool timeout. All four remain verification_incomplete, with null repository paths and no published cover assets.
No prior metric, description or cover validation is carried forward. Detail frames may auto-load without gameplay interaction.
Drive Mad body narrative attributes over 300 million plays since 2019 to Fancade. This historical claim is not a current Poki plays counter and is excluded from metrics.
Only selected verbatim factual DOM excerpts are embedded; full introductions, unrelated recommendations and ad or tracking iframe URLs are excluded.
